caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden wardrobe with a rich, brown color. The wardrobe has two vertically aligned doors, each featuring an ornate, arched decorative panel in the upper section, with the panels bordered by simple rectangular frames. Below the doors, the wardrobe contains two horizontal drawers, each fitted with a single round metal knob at the center. The wardrobe stands on a base with a scalloped or wavy edge at the front. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with no other objects or embellishments present. The lighting and shading give a sense of depth to the wardrobe and provide a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Wardrobe
